primary_source.role: PRIMARY practice reference; not a universal standard or executable specification

reading_scope: Full substantive article; linked official documentation checked for selected technical claims. No downloaded code executed.
attribution_boundary: Source-dependent content is restricted to identifiers, placement, short purpose labels, pointers and typed prerequisite edges. Capability contracts and adaptation points are original proposals for this repository, not claims that the source implements them.

dependency_semantics.required: Stated prerequisite or explicit narrative dependency; source_basis identifies which.
dependency_semantics.advisory: Source describes this as helpful or part of a maturity path, not an unconditional prerequisite.
dependency_semantics.conditional: Applies only under the recorded source condition.
dependency_semantics.empty_upstream: No play-to-play prerequisite stated for this subsection; does not imply absence of infrastructure, approved inputs or authorization.
dependency_semantics.relation: adoption, input, or control; do not collapse all three into a mandatory delivery sequence.
dependency_semantics.prose_precedence: Prose prerequisite language is used; diagram-only edges are not promoted to requirements. The implementation-plan prose is conditional on an existing record; instructions help policy skills but are not mandatory.

modes.observation: Mode behavior depends on session configuration; planning has a bypass-permissions exception. Inspect effective settings instead of inferring authority from the mode name.

memory.observation: Instruction files guide behavior; settings enforce supported restrictions. Discovery of AGENTS.md depends on host version and configuration. Verify actual loading.

skills.observation: Descriptions affect selection; malformed metadata may load without the intended fields. Supporting resources can load on demand. Validate discovery and behavior, not just Markdown syntax.

hooks.observation: Blocking is event- and result-specific. Several hook errors and PreToolUse timeouts do not themselves block execution; normal permission processing can continue.

subagents.observation: Helpers normally share the parent working directory. Worktree isolation is explicit, and teammate behavior differs. Context separation does not imply filesystem or credential isolation.

review.observation: Managed findings do not approve or block PRs; the check is neutral. Replying to a finding does not request a fix. Review and repair integrations are distinct.

actions.observation: The shared app grants broader permissions than the action alone uses. Trigger eligibility and bot checks matter. Available tool access also depends on invocation form.

sandbox.observation: The built-in boundary covers shell processes, not every client capability. Broad destinations, writable executables, sockets, and escape exceptions can defeat an intended restriction.

tag.observation: The linked product page describes a Slack beta for eligible Team/Enterprise accounts. Do not infer equivalent Teams support or installed connectors.

scans.observation: The linked product now names Mythos 5.1 while the article names Mythos 5. Record the actual scan model/version and provider terms rather than freezing the article example.
